settings.text: Smartsorb™ technology improves the bioavailability of CBD, so that more CBD gets into your system, in as little as 10 minutes. Smartsorb™ technology allows a greater amount of CBD to be delivered to your body, vs. other brands where 90% is destroyed by the digestive process. One capsule of NextEvo Premium Pure CBD with Smartsorb™  is equivalent to 4x the amount of CBD in oil-based formulations.

settings.subtitle: The Science
settings.title: How Smartsorb Works
settings.text: Smartsorb™ technology turns premium hemp-derived CBD into a water-soluble emulsion. This emulsion is optimized for precise delivery and timing, so that more of it gets into your body, and it works faster than oil-soluble CBD.
